title: Man arrested in Brighton allegedly had 124 forged debit cards in his car
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime Nicusor Lazar, 27, is facing a number of charges.

Boston Police Department Officers were conducting a traffic stop in Brighton on Tuesday afternoon when they recognized the driver as an individual detectives were seeking in an ongoing fraud investigation, the Boston Police Department said in a release.
Shortly after noon, officers initiated the traffic stop in the area of Harvard Avenue and Brainerd Road after a vehicle failed to stop at a red light, police said.

title: Murder charge filed against babysitter accused of leaving toddler in car for hours
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Local News The upgraded charges come after a grand jury indicted the woman from Martha’s Vineyard in connection with the toddler’s death.

Previously: A grand jury has upgraded the charges against Aimee Cotton in connection with the death of a 2-year-old boy on Martha’s Vineyard who was allegedly left unattended in a vehicle for hours last year.
Cotton was indicted Tuesday on charges of second-degree murder and reckless endangerment of a child, according to the Cape and Islands District Attorney’s Office.
